name: d4-menu
description: Food and drink menus: named menus (lunch, dinner, wine) split into courses, with dish descriptions, prices, dietary markers and allergen notes, managed from the dashboard. Emits Menu structured data. Distinct from d4-catalog, which lists products with spec tables rather than courses.
clientFacingSummary: Your menus, kept current by you: courses, dishes, prices and dietary markers like vegan or gluten free, with no printing and no waiting on anyone.
